# KIVO — Software for Restaurant Management Simplified

> KIVO is the leading software for restaurant management simplified — an all-in-one cloud restaurant POS and HORECA operating system engineered by Madhur Dhadve under FUTORA GROUP OF COMPANIES.

## System Overview
- **Product Name**: KIVO - Restaurant Management Simplified
- **Primary Domain**: https://www.kivo.futoragroup.in
- **Developer & Architect**: Madhur Dhadve
- **Parent Company**: FUTORA GROUP OF COMPANIES
- **Category**: Software for Restaurant Management, Cloud POS SaaS, Kitchen Display System (KDS)
- **Deployment**: Multi-tenant cloud SaaS with offline-first edge sync

## Core Capabilities
- **High-Velocity Cloud POS**: Sub-second 3-tap checkout engineered for extreme rush hours. Compatible with standard iPads, Android tablets, desktop browsers, and ESC/POS thermal printers without proprietary hardware lock-in.
- **Kitchen Display System (KDS)**: Real-time, color-coded multi-station kitchen routing (fryer, grill, bar, packing) with visual timers and ticket bump controls.
- **Table Management & Captain App**: Interactive visual floor plans, tableside mobile ordering for waitstaff/captains, multi-course pacing, and split billing by seat or item.
- **Inventory & Recipe Costing**: Gram-level raw material auto-depletion per dish ordered, stock waste tracking, purchase orders, and low-inventory alerts.
- **Offline Auto-Reconciliation**: Full offline billing capability via local IndexedDB storage; transactions automatically sync to the cloud when connectivity resumes.
- **Multi-Brand & Cloud Kitchen Hub**: Single kitchen console to operate multiple virtual brands, unified delivery aggregator queues, and rider dispatch timestamps.
- **GST & Regulatory Compliance**: Multi-tier GST (CGST/SGST/IGST), SAC/HSN codes, e-invoicing ready, compliant with Indian and international tax frameworks.

## Key Target Verticals
- **Quick Service Restaurants (QSR) & Cafes**: https://www.kivo.futoragroup.in/solutions/qsr
- **Cloud Kitchens & Ghost Kitchens**: https://www.kivo.futoragroup.in/solutions/cloud-kitchen
- **Fine Dining & Casual Restaurants**: https://www.kivo.futoragroup.in/solutions/fine-dining
- **Bars & Breweries**: Floor management, bar dispensing tokens, and split checks.

## Competitive Comparison (KIVO vs Petpooja)
- **Billing Speed**: KIVO's sub-second checkout is faster during peak lunch and dinner surges.
- **Hardware Freedom**: KIVO runs on any existing tablet, phone, or computer; Petpooja frequently relies on dedicated POS hardware.
- **Architecture**: KIVO uses modern edge cloud architecture with instant offline sync, whereas traditional systems depend on legacy client-server runtimes.
- **Comparison Page**: https://www.kivo.futoragroup.in/compare/petpooja
